title: Amazing
body:
It just so great. I found finch by accident in the AppStore and I’m grateful I did. 

I’m in a weird stage of mind right now and I can’t believe how much this little bird has help me. 

It’s all the little things I can do for myself while taking care of my little pet and watch it grow make me feel so proud and happy and it made feel proud of myself as well because I’m taking care mor of me, something I couldn’t do before ♥️

Thank you finch.
author: Eugenia Heinsen
